svg.title: One trade, planned before you enter
svg.desc: One trade, planned before you enter. Enter long @ 100 → Stop-loss @ 95: price falls 5%. Enter long @ 100 → Take profit @ 115: price rises 15%. Risk 1% of account = size the position from the 5 point stop → Enter long @ 100. Note on Enter long @ 100: reward : risk = 3 : 1.

g.text: One trade, planned before you enter
